claims.claim: Explicit reconcile-control-main requires exact RUN and SHA selectors, acquires the repository mutation lock, and gates reset on clean attached main, exact HEAD/upstream, canonical FAILURE transport, valid failure artifacts, and diverged common-base ancestry. Rejections invoke no RUN or Executor.

Reconciliation uses one native reset after proof gates, checks exact target HEAD and clean attached main, preserves remote failure refs and repository-local Runtime evidence, and creates no lifecycle artifact or publication.
Existing automatic synchronization implementations remain unchanged; reconciliation is called only by its explicit CLI branch.

Valid delivery-bound diagnostics retain their content-addressed ref and gain a family/SHA-256 delivery alias pointing to the same commit, with byte-identical replay, collision checks, atomic creation and absent-ref leases.

The read-only resolver queries exact deterministic refs in a disposable observer, validates schema, delivery binding and content identity, and returns only bounded cause facts or absence without scanning unrelated refs.

Operational Receipt v2 supports optional remote delivery lookup while preferring exact local journal/RUN attribution and local diagnostics; admission-derived receipts assert neither RUN creation nor Executor invocation.

Added regression cases cover the transported diverged topology, destructive proof gates, automatic synchronization separation, legacy refs, alias replay/collisions, all three delivery families and receipt precedence. Changes are confined to authorized files, and README documents the authority boundaries.
